context: The compliance check's design part expects web screens (a design folder, tokens, a screenshot config). ios-adblock is an iPhone app plus a Chrome extension, so it fails a check that does not fit it. home is the same kind of repo.

options.gain: No false failure in iPhone repos.
options.label: Mark design not applicable for iPhone-only screens, and fix the shared check
options.lose: iPhone screens get no automatic screen check.

options.gain: A real check of iPhone screens.
options.how: The check shoots each screen in the simulator (one at a time, under your item 73 a) and judges it like a web screen.
options.label: Build an iPhone screenshot check
options.lose: New tooling, and Mac time for every run.

ref: r1 (compliance visit, ios-adblock); c91 (one iOS standard)

title: How should the compliance check judge an iPhone app's screens?
why: It stops a false failure now; an iPhone screenshot check can come later with c91.
